Flame SlashBasic
Deals 280% ATK DMG to a single enemy.
Darkflame TorrentActiveExclusive Lv.1
Deals 240% ATK DMG to an enemy target and 2 random enemies, with a 40% chance to inflict 1 layer of [HP Burning] for 2 turns.
Flame Claymore Lv.1Darkflame Torrent: Doubles the chance to inflict [HP Burning]. If this skill fails to inflict [HP Burning], reduces the target's ATK by 20% for 2 turns.
Flame PowerPassiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
Leuf restores his HP by 36% of Max HP when he inflicts a kill. Meanwhile, he inflicts 1 layer of [HP Burning] on the enemy target with the lowest HP percentage for 2 turns.
Flame Claymore Lv.2Flame Power: No longer inflicts [HP Burning] on the enemy target with the lowest HP, and instead inflicts [HP Burning] on all enemies for 2 turns.
Flame Claymore Lv.3When Leuf attacks an enemy under [HP Burning] status, each stage of attack deals extra DMG, which equals 1.5% of the target's Max HP multiplies the layer of [HP Burning] the target has and caps at 4.5% of Leuf's Max HP. The extra DMG can be considered as [HP Burning] DMG.
Flame Sword BlastActive
Deals 3 stages of 185% ATK DMG each to a single enemy, with a 40% chance to inflict 1 layer of [HP Burning] for 2 turns.
